report.career_summary: Orestas Rimkus is a Lithuanian-born runner based in New Zealand who has assembled a focused eight-race marathon record across Christchurch and Queenstown. His 2:36:27 PB (2nd overall, Queenstown 2024) and a 3rd-place finish at Queenstown 2023 (2:38:06) establish him as a top-three competitor at one of New Zealand's most competitive marathons. His improvement from 2:51:02 in 2018 to 2:36:27 in 2024 is one of the most dramatic in the archive.
report.trajectory: Clear and sustained improvement: 2:51:02 (CHC 2018) → 2:44:31 (QT 2020) → 2:37:34 (CHC 2021) → 2:38:06 (QT 2023) → 2:36:27 (QT 2024, PB). His 2025 Christchurch result (2:43:17) represents a moderate step back, but the overall arc is strongly upward. The 14-minute improvement over six years reflects dedicated long-term development.
report.best_result: 2nd overall at the 2024 Queenstown Marathon (2:36:27) in a field of 2,522 — a top-0.04% result. His 3rd place at Queenstown 2023 (2:38:06) in a field of approximately 2,400 is equally strong. These back-to-back Queenstown podium finishes make him one of the most competitive marathon runners in the NZ South Island circuit.
report.distance_profile: Rimkus races exclusively at the marathon distance. His one half marathon result (1:16:33, Christchurch 2019) projects to a full marathon of approximately 2:42 — he has clearly surpassed that projection with his current PB of 2:36:27, indicating strong marathon-specific adaptation. A 1:12–1:13 half would be more consistent with his current marathon form.
report.where_to_race: Queenstown Marathon is where he excels — two consecutive podium finishes (3rd and 2nd). The Queenstown course suits his strength-based running style. Christchurch has also yielded good results (11th/600 in 2021).
report.qualifying_note: His marathon PB of 2:36:27 qualifies for Boston under the M 18–34 standard (3:00:00) with 23 minutes margin. As he moves into M30–34 (current), he has time to improve further. A sub-2:30 is a realistic medium-term target at his current rate of improvement.
